children: Saudi Aramco has the flexibility to rapidly increase oil supply, Barclays analyst Lydia Rainforth writes after hosting the company at the Barclays Energy-Power Conference. The Saudi Arabian national oil company can increase its output to 10 million barrels a day in two days, and reach 12 million barrels a day within approximately three weeks, she writes. "This responsiveness gives Aramco an ability to add supply materially faster than new industry projects can be developed," she writes.(adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
